name: microblog-api
description: Microblog API with Hono + Cloudflare Workers

scripts.preview:dry-run: npm run preview:preflight && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.toml --dry-run
scripts.preview:db:migrate: npm run preview:preflight && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.preview.toml
scripts.preview:deploy: npm run preview:preflight && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.toml
scripts.db:generate: wrangler d1 migrations create microblog-db init
